name: Cable
description: Cable knit: two cords crossing at a fixed lean that reverses on every row.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 4%; width: 58%; height: 92%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(20deg); transform: rotate(20deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; top: 4%; width: 58%; height: 92%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-20deg); transform: rotate(-20deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { :before { -webkit-transform: rotate(-20deg); transform: rotate(-20deg); } :after { -webkit-transform: rotate(20deg); transform: rotate(20deg); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
